deferredPreviewContract: Export behaviour to restore once previews are wired: iframe 1440x900, scaled to wrapper width / 1440, translated to the target block (doc.querySelector('[data-r="<key>"]') || doc.getElementById(key)), wrapper height = block height x scale, header forced to position:relative for non-header targets, refit on resize via ResizeObserver, fade in opacity .3s.

deviations: Swatch internals are <span> instead of <div> (a <button> may only contain phrasing content); rendering is pixel-identical.

Decorative overview illustrations, swatch chips, spacing bars and radius/shadow previews are aria-hidden; icon SVGs are aria-hidden + focusable=false.
Organisms illustration: the push to the right moved from margin-left:auto on the first link to margin-right:auto on the logo (identical layout).
On load the page is scrolled back to the top, because the hash selects a page rather than a scroll target. The export behaves this way implicitly, since its content renders after the fragment jump.
Clipboard failure is swallowed (.catch) to avoid an unhandled rejection; the toast still shows, as in the export.

Class naming: dc components use their data-attribute identity (data-abq-btn -> .abq-btn) or component name; catalog specimens use the class named in their caption (abq-button--primary, abq-tag, ...). Elements use block_element, modifiers --modifier, as in batch 1.
Headings: live-frame titles are <h3>, library titles <h4>, the Button "Links & icons" heading <h5>; SectionHeading and abq-section-head keep their own <h2> (component contract). No level is skipped.
ProductCard root is <article> with a stretched link instead of <a> wrapping <button>s (invalid nesting in the source).
Choice and FormField use native inputs; Choice adds a :focus-visible outline (keyboard access is new; the source rows were not focusable).
